## Course feedback form   
Please help us improve the course and the materials we provide! Fill out the course feedback form [here](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfah66t6TKM4tlYb7lG2mKUOvCjZTyFWsRBH3TMwgVy50AW6g/viewform?usp=dialog)
  
## The Venue
The course will be held at Conference Center Wallenberg (link to information about the venue), located at Medicinaregatan 20 (link to google maps).

Our room is **Antarctis**. The room is on the ground floor, turn left after you enter through the main doors and look for the SND logo!

## Transport
The nearest tram stop is Göteborg Medicinaregatan (link to Västtrafik). You can pay for public transport in Gothenburg city by tapping a credit card (link to Västtrafik). Otherwise, you can purchase tickets and plan travel with the Västtrafik To Go app (link to Västtrafik).

There is ample parking very close to the venue, you pay with one of the generic commercial parking apps. 
 
## Fika & lunch 
The course fee includes afternoon coffee and light refreshments on 4 May, and lunch plus morning and afternoon coffee and refreshments on the remaining days (5–7 May). 

## Suggested credits:
**2 hp. Note: SND can only provide a suggested number of credits; you must apply to your university department to have the credits formally approved after completing the course.**
